title: Fee Schedule: Improper Parking and Lost or Stolen Vehicles, Wayfare Bikes and Scooters
content:
Fleet fees of the Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plans for vehicles ended outside a station or parking zone and for vehicles not returned, in US dollars.

## Improper parking

The improper parking fee is the fee when a vehicle is ended outside a station or parking zone. The first-offense setting states whether the first improper parking in 12 months gets a warning instead of the fee, and the lookback is the period, in months, over which that first offense is judged.

| Plan | Improper parking fee | First improper parking in the lookback gets a warning instead of the fee | Lookback for the first-offense warning (months) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | 25.00 | Yes | 12 |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | 25.00 | Yes | 12 |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | 25.00 | Yes | 12 |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | 25.00 | Yes | 12 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | 25.00 | Yes | 12 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | 25.00 | Yes | 12 |

## Lost or stolen vehicles

A ride not ended the threshold number of elapsed hours after unlock is treated as a lost or stolen vehicle. The fee depends on the vehicle type.

| Plan | Threshold (elapsed hours after unlock) | Classic bike | E-bike | Scooter |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | 24 | 1200.00 | 2500.00 | 1000.00 |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | 24 | 1200.00 | 2500.00 | 1000.00 |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | 24 | 1200.00 | 2500.00 | 1000.00 |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | 24 | 1200.00 | 2500.00 | 1000.00 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | 24 | 1200.00 | 2500.00 | 1000.00 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | 24 | 1200.00 | 2500.00 | 1000.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- The figures are the same on every plan; only the vehicle type changes the lost or stolen vehicle fee.
- An e-bike treated as lost or stolen carries a fee of 2500.00, a classic bike 1200.00 and a scooter 1000.00.
- Hours are elapsed hours counted from the moment of unlock: a vehicle unlocked at 08:00 on a hypothetical Tuesday and still not ended at 09:00 on the Wednesday has gone 25 elapsed hours without being ended, beyond the 24-hour threshold; the same vehicle still out at 20:00 on the Tuesday has gone 12 hours, within it.
